defs.def: the coldest season of the year, between autumn/fall and spring 冬天；冬季verb

ex.s: Not too long ago, on a cold winter night, there was a teenager who wanted more screen time and a parent who said no.
ex.t: 不久前，在一个寒冷的冬夜，有一个想要更多屏幕时间的少年，和一位说“不行”的家长。

ex.s: They can also enjoy themselves in the themed classes like Harry Potter or Winter Wonder-land Baking.
ex.t: 他们还可以在哈利·波特或冬季仙境烘焙等主题课上尽情玩耍。

ex.s: I find during the winter months, plants around the house can really lift your mood.” Several studies have backed this up and found that indoor plants can improve creativity, focus and memory.
ex.t: 我发现在冬季的几个月里，房子周围的植物真的能提振你的情绪。”多项研究证实了这一点，发现室内植物可以提高创造力、专注力和记忆力。

ex.s: And last winter, I definitely needed a reset.
ex.t: 而去年冬天，我确实需要一个重新调整。

ex.s: Holding hands in the freezing lake, we looked out for each other last winter and will do so through this one.
ex.t: 在冰冷的湖里握手，我们去年冬天互相照顾，并且会通过这个湖来这样做。

ex.s: As another winter sets in, I’m more than ready to embrace the cold again.
ex.t: 当又一个冬天来临时，我已经准备好再次拥抱寒冷了。

ex.s: For instance, you might hear someone say: “It’s cold this winter, so I needn’t worry about global warming.”Another is that loud and urgent matters are given too much importance, making people ignore longer-term trends that arguably matter more.
ex.t: 例如，你可能听到有人说：“今年冬天很冷，所以我不用为全球变暖担心。”另一个问题是，喧闹而紧迫的事被赋予过多重要性，使人们忽视了 arguably 更重要的长期趋势。

ex.s: The snow was marked only by small animals: foxes, coyotes, mice, and varying hares, which turned white in the winter.”
ex.t: 雪地上只有小动物留下的痕迹：狐狸、土狼、老鼠，以及冬天会变成白色的雪鞋兔。

ex.s: They are winter images.
ex.t: 它们是冬季图像。

ex.s: Open: Mon to Sat and Summer Sundays 10.30 -17.00 Sumner.10.30 -16.00 Winter.
ex.t: 开放时间：周一至周六及夏季周日 10:30 -17:00 夏季。10:30 -16:00 冬季。

ex.s: To celebrate a winter holiday.
ex.t: 为了庆祝一个冬季节日。

ex.s: This was so that the person could keep their home warm for the winter.
ex.t: 这样那个人就可以让家在整个冬天都保持温暖。

ex.s: Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is road testing a new way to keep winter roads ice-free -by spreading on them cheese brine, the salty liquid used to make soft cheeses, like mozzarella.
ex.t: 威斯康星州密尔沃基市正在道路测试一种保持冬季道路无冰的新方法——在上面撒奶酪卤水，即制作马苏里拉奶酪等软奶酪时使用的咸味液体。

ex.s: Many people suspect that all the rock salt used every winter is harming the environment.
ex.t: 许多人怀疑每年使用的所有岩盐都在损害环境。

ex.s: Why can cheese brine help keep winter roads ice-free?
ex.t: 为什么奶酪卤水能帮助保持冬季道路无冰？

ex.s: During my last winter holiday, I went to countryside with my father to visit my grandparents.
ex.t: 去年寒假期间，我和父亲一起回乡下看望祖父母。

ex.s: Last winter when I went here again, they had a big separate house to raise dozens of chicken.
ex.t: 去年冬天我再去了一次，他们有了一间独立的大屋，养了几十只鸡。

ex.s: Winter Market   8th November
ex.t: 冬季集市 11月8日

ex.s: They were unable to stand the winter.
ex.t: 他们无法忍受冬天。

ex.s: Norphel’s inspiration came from seeing the waste of water over winter, when it was not needed.
ex.t: 诺普尔的灵感来自于看到冬季水的浪费，那时水并不需要。

ex.s: Eventually, it manages to reach the places where it will spend the winter.
ex.t: 最终，它设法抵达了将要过冬的地方。

ex.s: It will spend the winter there.
ex.t: 它会在那里过冬

ex.s: During autumn, these same mountains are gold, and in winter they are covered in sheets white frost.
ex.t: 秋天，这些山峦一片金黄，冬天则覆盖着一层白霜。

ex.s: We have cold winters and hot summers.
ex.t: 我们有寒冷的冬季和炎热的夏季。

ex.s: Adapted from a work by Schopenhauer One cold winter night, a group of porcupines gathered together to keep warm.
ex.t: 改编自叔本华的作品在一个寒冷的冬夜，一群豪猪聚集在一起取暖。
